title: "Pixels" - music video that recreates many fantastic games with power of the AI.
author: SoullessGamesDev
selftext:
It is not a video game by itself, but a music video that are using the power of AI to give new look to all kinds of games, from old to most recent ones. Treat it as an experiment - how all of those games could look if they were made with graphics made with AI? 

In this track, I’ve blended light rock with the melodies of retro gaming - the very sounds that first introduced me to the world of video games, a world that gave my life meaning and purpose. For over two decades, I’ve both created games of my own and enjoyed those crafted by others. Today, I want to share this song with you: a reflection of my deep admiration for the wonderful worlds born from human imagination, and also an experiment: how those games could look like with slightly different visuals? 

Many scenes in the music video recreate characters or the atmosphere from a wide variety of games across many different genres, while some serve as nods to entire genres themselves. Will you be able to recognize them all?

The lyrics is in Ukrainian, if someone is interested - here is a translation: 

\[Verse\] 

Nerves like wires, 

I feel only fatigue

Barely alive, 

I drag myself home. 

The gray sky presses down 

On the concrete box

And another night 

Will be spent without sleep. 

Escaping into a fairy tale 

Where adventure awaits

And the world all around 

Burns with vivid colors! 

Far away from the sorrow, 

From the horror and pain

To a place where my soul 

Can finally break free! 

\[Pre-Chorus\] 

This world is cruel

And filled with filth

I refuse to live

IN A PLACE LIKE THIS!!! 

\[Chorus\] 

Pixels shine brighter than the sun itself! 

Here, even if I’m killed, I’ll rise again! 

Every adventure is like a burst of stars

Boldly I step between two worlds! 

I dive into a realm of pure code 

To find true freedom within 

I fall into the depths of the screen

And I’m never turning back! 

\[Verse\] 

Wildly beautiful

The way the light is traced

An atmospheric soundtrack 

That makes my heart bloom. 

All the characters 

Are deep and intriguing

The stories are gripping 

Though sometimes bloody. 

Leveling up and grinding, 

Discovering new zones

They save me 

During the gray winter season.

In the life I despise, 

I wasn't truly myself

But here, I have found 

A WORLD WHERE DREAMS COME TRUE!!! 

\[Chorus\] 

Pixels brighter than my own sun! 

Here I shall rise again, should I be undone! 

Every adventure here like a burst of stars

I take a step between two worlds! 

I dive into a realm of pure code

To find a true freedom within. 

I fall into the depths of the screen

And I shall never returnI! 

\[Outro\] 

There is no king here 

To command me to die 

I have no house 

That tomorrow might burn. 

There is always a choice

My own path I’ll chart

This old computer 

Is now my temple

I’ll live out my days here, 

A thousands of lives

Will format my memroy 

Clearing out all the lies

I press "Delete" 

And erasing the life 

Into the pixels I plunge... 

NEVER TO RETURN!!!
